_comment: Gemini->Responses contract. Client requests a JSON array (no ?alt=sse); upstream streams Responses SSE. Body must be one closed array; no [DONE], no bare EOF.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-resp"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
name: gemini_to_responses_json_array_stream
